home.processLead: Building work can feel like a leap into the unknown. Here's what happens, step by step, so you always know what's next.
home.ctaLead: Tell us a little about your home and what you'd like to do. We'll get back to you to talk it through, with no pressure and no hard sell.

process.title: A quick chat
process.text: Call us or send the form. We'll ask a few questions about your home and what you have in mind. It usually takes about 10 minutes.

process.title: We visit your home
process.text: We come and look at the space, talk through ideas and give you an honest view on what's possible, including what might need planning permission.

process.title: Drawings and approvals
process.text: We build from your plans or introduce you to a designer we trust. We help with planning and arrange Building Regulations approval.

process.title: A clear, written quote
process.text: You get an itemised quote so you can see where the money goes. Take your time to decide. We won't chase you.

process.title: The build
process.text: We agree a start date and plan the work around your household. The same team is on site throughout, and we keep you updated every week.

process.title: Handover and aftercare
process.text: We walk through everything with you, fix any snags and hand over your certificates. If something isn't right later, call us and we'll come back.

about.title: A family firm from Hythe, since 1995
about.lead: We're Adams & Barford. We've been building homes, extensions and conversions across the Waterside, the New Forest and Southampton since 1995, and we're still the same family.
about.story:
Paul Adams and Lyndsey Barford started Adams & Barford in Hythe in 1995. From the beginning, the idea was simple: do the work properly, treat people's homes with respect, and be someone customers would happily recommend to a friend.

That's how we've grown ever since. For most of our history we haven't advertised at all. Our work has come from word of mouth: people we've built for before, and their friends, family and neighbours. One customer has worked with us on four different properties. That means more to us than any advert.

We've specialised in home refurbishments, extensions, and loft and garage conversions, and over time we've added new homes, oak-framed buildings and commercial work. What hasn't changed is how we work. We're still family-run, and you'll see the same faces from the first visit to the day we hand over. You won't be passed between a salesperson, a project manager and a string of strangers. You'll deal with people you get to know, who are accountable for the whole job.

Most of our customers stay at home while we build, so we've become experts at working around family life. That means keeping a kitchen running, tidying up every day, and telling you what's happening before it happens.

We're still based in Hythe, and most of our work is within a short drive of home, across the Waterside, the New Forest and Southampton.

areas.title: Where we work
areas.lead: We're based in Hythe and build across the Waterside, the New Forest and Southampton.
areas.body:
Hythe has been home since 1995, and most of our work is within a short drive of it. That means we can be on site early, pop back quickly if something needs a look, and we already know many of the local roads, planners and suppliers.

## The Waterside

Hythe, Dibden Purlieu, Holbury, Fawley and Marchwood are on our doorstep. A lot of our customers here found us through a neighbour, and some of them we've built for more than once.

## The New Forest

We work across the Forest, including Lyndhurst, Brockenhurst, Beaulieu, Lymington and Ringwood. Building inside the New Forest National Park has its own rules. Planning is handled by the National Park Authority, and it looks closely at size, design and materials. We'll help you understand what's likely to be possible before you spend money on drawings.

## Southampton and Totton

From Totton to the city, we build extensions, loft and garage conversions and renovations on all kinds of homes. We also carry out commercial refurbishments for local businesses.

Not sure if you're in our area? Get in touch anyway. We'll tell you honestly whether we can take your project on.
